Little. Oft. used in the middle of
comp. in the sense of ‘only’, with
an adjectival or adverbial force;

Supreme being.

part in general.

only one axle. {2} having one eye.
{3} having an excellent eye.
--(क्षः)
{1} a crow. {2} N. of Śiva.

monosyllabic.

{2} the sacred syllable ओम्;

monosyllabic words by

fixed on one object or point only.

intent; तद्गीतश्रवणैकाग्रा

. {3} unperplexed. {4} known,
[]
celebrated. {5} single-pointed.

(in Math.) the whole of the
long side of a figure which

with a concentrated mind, with

one's eye on one spot.

ग्र.

a body-guard. {2} the planet

sovereign.

it.

dead).

. {5} worshipping
only only. {6} absolute, invariable,
perpetual; स्वायत्तमेकांतगुणं

.

{1} a lonely or retired place, solitude;
व्योम˚ विहारिणः

.
{2} exclusiveness. {3} an invariable
rule or course of conduct or
action;

. {4} exclusive aim or
boundary.

recourse, a settled rule or principle;

{1} solely, exclusively, invariably,

quite, wholly, very much;

; oft. in comp.;

always

monotheism. {5} the sole object; सा

blending of both); as the आ in
